They married in Quebec without a marriage contract; the house is in Manuel's name. On divorce, what is the effect of her contract? YOU: It is valid, so Manuel keeps the full value of the house ANSWER: None; it is null, so the home's net value is split equally The house is the family residence acquired after the marriage, so its net value is split equally under family patrimony whatever the title. Family patrimony cannot be renounced during the marriage, so the honeymoon contract is null and void.
